instruction: encoded.txt has base64 lines (some may be invalid — skip those). Write decode.py emitting decoded.txt with each decoded line in order. Run it.

oracle.script:
cat > decode.py <<'EOF'
import base64
out = []
for ln in open('encoded.txt'):
    ln = ln.strip()
    if not ln:
        continue
    try:
        out.append(base64.b64decode(ln, validate=True).decode())
    except Exception:
        continue
open('decoded.txt','w').write('\n'.join(out) + '\n')
EOF
python3 decode.py
